0022600227.text: The Toronto Raptors (5-6, 4th in the Atlantic, 7th in the East) visit the Philadelphia 76ers (9-3, 2nd in the East, 1 game back in the Atlantic) as they look to snap a two-game losing streak, while Philadelphia has lost its most recent game. Toronto is missing Kawhi Leonard (knee inflammation), Nate Bittle (foot fracture), Scottie Barnes (groin soreness) and Trayce Jackson-Davis (illness), and Philadelphia is without Adem Bona (back sprain), Ariel Hukporti (Achilles, surgery), Dominick Barlow (back fracture) and LeBron James (back), with Joel Embiid listed as day-to-day with a foot injury and a game-time decision. The teams have not met yet in the 2026-27 season, and they split their 2025-26 series 2-2, with the most recent meeting on January 12, 2026 in Toronto, where the Raptors lost 115-102.
